title: Professional Certificate Course in Performance Monitoring and Evaluation
description: The aim of this course is to provide learners with a fundamental understanding of employee performance and its management in the healthcare industry.
longDescription: The Concept of Employee Performance. Performance Monitoring and Evaluation. The Concept of Performance Management. The Concept of Goal Theory and SMART Goals. Key Performance Challenges Faced in Healthcare Industry. Key Performance Indicators in Health and Social Care. Probation period Types of Performance Review Systems. Performance Appraisal. Benchmarking Codes of Practice. Disciplinary The Concept of Diversity. The aim of this course is to provide learners with a comprehensive understanding of employee performance and its management in the healthcare industry. By the end of this course, learners will be able to identify key performance challenges, monitor and evaluate employee performance, apply goal theory and SMART goals, conduct performance appraisals and reviews, benchmark organizational performance, understand codes of practice, handle disciplinary issues, and promote workplace diversity, leading to improved employee performance and organizational success. courseDetails: This course aims to provide learners with a comprehensive understanding of employee performance management in the healthcare industry. By the end of this course, learners will be able to understand the concept of employee performance and its impact on organizational success. Learn about performance monitoring and evaluation, performance management, and performance appraisal methods. Identify key performance challenges and indicators in health and social care and learn how to measure them. Understand the importance of diversity, codes of practice, and disciplinary issues in managing employee performance effectively.
